eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, B = g.birds, w = g.weapon, inp = g.input; window.__tick = (n = 1) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); w.update(1 / 30); B.update(1 / 30); g.particles.update(1 / 30); inp.endFrame(); } }; window.__look = (pt) => { const e = g.engine.camera.position; const dx = pt.x - e.x, dy = pt.y - e.y, dz = pt.z - e.z; p.yaw = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz); p.pitch = Math.atan2(dy, Math.hypot(dx, dz)); p.update(1 / 30); g.engine.camera.updateMatrixWorld(); }; window.__scope = (on) => { if (on !== w.aimToggled) inp.buttonsPressed |= 4; for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); w.update(1 / 30); inp.endFrame(); } }; window.__fire = () => { for (let i = 0; i < 90 && w.state !== 'ready'; i++) __tick(); inp.buttonsPressed |= 1; w.update(1 / 30); inp.endFrame(); const s = g.hunting.lastShot; return { tipo: s.kind, dist: Number.isFinite(s.distance) ? +s.distance.toFixed(1) : null, letal: s.lethal, pontos: s.points, especie: s.bird ? s.bird.species.id : null }; }; p.position.set(-29, g.terrain.heightAt(-29, -28), -28); p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); p.crouched = true; g.chunks.warmup(p.position); for (let i = B.active.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) B.release(i); B.spawnTimer = 1e9; const v = p.position.clone(); window.__targets = []; const sabia = B.speciesList.find(s => s.id === 'sabia'); for (let k = 0; k < 80 && __targets.length < 1; k++) { if (!g.chunks.randomPerch(p.position.x, p.position.z, 18, 40, v)) continue; const b = B.spawnPerched(sabia, v, false, null); b.idleTime = 1e9; __targets.push(b); } __tick(2); return __targets.map(b => ({ especie: b.species.id, dist: +b.pos.distanceTo(p.position).toFixed(1), altura: +(b.pos.y - g.terrain.heightAt(b.pos.x, b.pos.z)).toFixed(1) })); })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, B = g.birds; __scope(false); const e = g.engine.camera.position; let tree = null; for (const c of g.chunks.loaded.values()) { const t = c.trunks; for (let i = 0; i < t.length; i += 4) { const d = Math.hypot(t[i] - e.x, t[i + 1] - e.z); if (d > 8 && d < 30 && t[i + 3] > e.y + 3 && (!tree || d < tree.d)) tree = { x: t[i], z: t[i + 1], r: t[i + 2], d }; } } if (!tree) return 'sem tronco'; const dx = (tree.x - e.x) / tree.d, dz = (tree.z - e.z) / tree.d; const pos = e.clone(); pos.x = tree.x + dx * (tree.r + 1.2); pos.z = tree.z + dz * (tree.r + 1.2); const b = B.spawnPerched(B.speciesList[1], pos, false, null); b.idleTime = 1e9; window.__hidden = b; __look(b.pos); const r = __fire(); return { ...r, troncoA: +tree.d.toFixed(1), passaroVivo: b.alive, placar: g.hunting.score }; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, B = g.birds, p = g.player; __scope(true); B.frozen = true; const e = g.engine.camera.position; const f = { x: -Math.sin(p.yaw), z: -Math.cos(p.yaw) }, r = { x: Math.cos(p.yaw), z: -Math.sin(p.yaw) }; const jay = B.speciesList.find(s => s.id === 'gralha'); const pos = e.clone(); pos.x += f.x * 15; pos.z += f.z * 15; pos.y += 4; const b = B.spawnPerched(jay, pos, false, null); b.showcase(pos, p.yaw + Math.PI, 0.9, 0); window.__wing = b; const off = jay.span * jay.length * 0.65; const aim = pos.clone(); aim.x += r.x * off; aim.z += r.z * off; __look(aim); const res = __fire(); B.frozen = false; return { ...res, estado: b.state, placar: g.hunting.score }; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, B = g.birds, p = g.player; const e = g.engine.camera.position; const f = { x: -Math.sin(p.yaw), z: -Math.cos(p.yaw) }; for (let i = 0; i < 90 && g.weapon.state !== 'ready'; i++) __tick(); const pisco = B.speciesList.find(s => s.id === 'pisco'); const pos = e.clone(); pos.x += f.x * 4; pos.z += f.z * 4; pos.y -= 0.3; const b = B.spawnPerched(pisco, pos, false, null); b.idleTime = 1e9; window.__close = b; __look(b.pos); const r = __fire(); __tick(120); __look(b.pos); return { ...r, estado: b.state }; })()
